sleep_driver_pattern: N/A (waking goal-pipeline onboarding scheduler; no sleep loop)
substrate: scaffolded_sd054_onboarding (full curriculum; 603n config; ready=true 2026-06-11) + commitment control-plane (bistable BetaGate + SD-034 ClosureOperator + SD-033a LateralPFC + SD-032 dACC/salience) + subgoal_mode waypoint tolerance-band completion env primitive.
method_note: 466b's SD-034 satisficing/residue-discharge mechanism (closure ON discharges rule-domain residue at completed-with-stable-rule_state ticks; closure OFF accumulates residue unchecked) re-run on a foraging-competent agent BUILT THROUGH the scaffolded_sd054_onboarding curriculum. 466b's committed_mode_curriculum trained commitment but NOT foraging competence and never set subgoal_mode=True, so completions never occurred (n_closures=0).
readiness_note: TWO non-vacuity gates self-route a substrate-not-engaged read to non_contributory (never a false weakens): the 603n contact guard + the commitment+completion non-vacuity gate (closure had an opportunity to fire).
arm_note: ARM_CLOSURE_ON vs ARM_CLOSURE_OFF (same trained weights, closure off). The committed_mode_curriculum O-2 forced-rv contrast arm is dropped.

stage_plan.name: nursery_forced_feed
stage_plan.desc: forced supra-threshold benefit; z_goal formation decoupled from survival

stage_plan.name: guided_low_conflict
stage_plan.desc: reef-refuge spawn, hfa=0, goal pipeline frozen; encoder/E2/E3 warm-up

stage_plan.name: easy_foraging
stage_plan.desc: goal pipeline unfrozen, low hazard; ecological contact begins

stage_plan.name: mature_test
stage_plan.desc: frozen-policy measurement under guarded hfa; substrate gate evaluated

preconditions.name: commitment_and_completion_engaged
preconditions.description: ON arm committed (total_beta_elevated > 0) AND reached completions (n_sequence_completions > 0) on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds -- so closure HAD an opportunity to fire its residue discharge (the n_closures=0 *b-cohort gap).
preconditions.control: fraction of guard-passing seeds with ON commitment AND completions.

contact_guard.definition: per-seed P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4; < 2/3 seeds -> substrate_not_ready_requeue.

completion_non_vacuity_gate.definition: ON total_beta_elevated > 0 AND n_sequence_completions > 0 on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory), NEVER a false weakens.
